exact_result: Unverified research proofs reconstruct middle-positive ordinary Borel multiplication and positivity for every locally bounded generated-Psh ordinal stage; prove mixed symmetry with one continuous generated-Psh factor for arbitrary original currents; and prove continuous-pair compatibility is preserved by differentiation with any locally bounded, possibly discontinuous generated-Psh potential, smooth positive closed decorations, and weak positive limits. A fixed convolution kernel cannot commute with both split-torus monomial shears. Original every-current P21.3 is unresolved.
concrete_gaps: No local weak exhaustion of an arbitrary original positive doubly closed ordinary current by the constructed compatible-current class has been proved, including compatibility on all analytic moment refinements.
Equal canonical Hessian currents of a general continuous generated-Psh pair have not supplied a fixed-neighbourhood generated construction for both signs of its difference.
The mixed symmetry identity still contains D(hT) for an arbitrary current and cannot itself set that current to zero from D[h]=0.

No analytic counterexample with two separately admissible finite continuous generated-Psh potentials, upstairs canonical Hessian equality, an allowed current, and a detecting compact smooth test has been constructed.
